entry.title: Tree Remote
entry.summary:
Vendor: King of Christmas
Type: Christmas Accessories
Price: 15.00

Make your home glow with ease using the King of Christmas Tree Remote Control, designed to bring the beauty of your tree to life with just the touch of a button.

Please note:

  • This remote is compatible with King of Christmas tree models from 2021 and newer.

  • Functions vary by tree model, so be sure to check your tree’s product page for specific features.

  • Not compatible with the Silverpeak Fir™ or Windsor Family collections.

  •  Must point the remote toward the foot pedal for it to work properly.

FINAL SALE. NO RETURNS OR EXCHANGES.
